mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate level is inversely related to equity returns; higher rates consistently produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and 20d S&P 500 returns show a positive or insignificant correlation (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% and industrial production falls below 100.0, it signals an imminent recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0 AND INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined as FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300.0, it signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: The consumer price index level is inversely related to equity returns; higher inflation consistently produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL and 5d S&P 500 returns show a positive or insignificant correlation (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5.
